doc: Declared <<event name args...>> names (docs/kb/tech/dialogue_format.md). tools/dlgc.py rejects unknown names and checks the positional args with the cue arg types (id, number, int, bool, string, emotion, enum). test_only events are allowed only in game/data/dialogue/test/.

events.doc: Open a zone for free movement once the scene ends.
Hand off to a battle once the scene ends.
The player chose not to leave yet (M2-FP-21, B05 at Haluna's causeway head): the host returns control instead of handing off.
Ch1 C1-08 (the scale-hull): Rhen haggled the scale-man up; the chapter flow pays the few extra lume (expression only, no flag).
Ch1 C1-13 (the breaking raft): Rhen chose "Kell first"; the chapter flow starts the run at her bridge instead of the net-pen path.

Hand off to a Reefball match once the scene ends (act1_ch07.md §5; M3-C07-02, modelled on start_battle). The chapter flow reads it with an if_event step and runs the zone's match beat; the match sets ch07_tidecup_played (and ch07_tidecup_won on a win, a reward only) and returns to the zone.

A no-fail held input inside a cutscene (M3-C09-02; act1_ch09.md B04-B07, the Ebbing; shared with act3_ending E4). From here to hold_input_end the scene's time runs only while the player holds the host's action (CutsceneHoldGate): waits, walks and fades advance while it is held and stand still when it is let go. No timing, no score, no fail. prompt names the prompt row in the host's data (a loc key).
Ends the held input hold_input began: the scene's time runs on its own again and the prompt goes.

M4-CIN-1302 (act2_ch10.md B09, the farewell-tide): a no-fail release. From here the scene's time stands still while the player holds the host's action, and the scene goes on the first moment it is let go (CutsceneHoldGate's release gate). Put it straight after a hold_input_end, so the player is holding when it opens. No timer, no fail. prompt names the prompt row in the host's data (a loc key, e.g. "Release").

Shows the act card between acts (M3-C09-09; act1_ch09.md B11, the end of Act I). ActCard (game/ui/cards/act_card.gd) listens to the scene's sequencer and shows act's row of game/data/ui/act_card.json.
